shared_tail.surface: صالح بن أبي مريم أبي الخليل

notes: «حدثنا معاذ» in the first branch and «معاذ بن هشام» at the convergence are one man written twice (rule 7): the fuller form is kept once, in the shared tail
«حدثني أبي» is a relation with no name in the text
«أن رجلا، من بني عامر بن صعصعة» is in the scene; Umm al-Fadl relays the Prophet's answer
«ابن، بشار» is written with an attached «و» removed from «وابن»
